main.description: A backdated point in a character's arc — one per meaningful beat. The series, ordered by createdAt, lets a reader scrub the character changing over the campaign. Precedent: supper_club_secrets character.stateEvent.

subject.description: AT-URI of the character.profile this event belongs to.

state.description: One-line emotional/situational descriptor at this beat.

storyDate.description: In-world date as a PLAIN STRING (fantasy calendars allowed, e.g. '14th of Hammer, 1492 DR'). Never parsed as a real datetime.

chapterRef.description: Chapter this beat was revealed in.

createdAt.description: Set to the beat's real ordering timestamp so the series sorts chronologically. Distinct from storyDate.
